title: Identify the names and full mailing addresses of exclusively virtual school
question: Identify the names and full mailing addresses of exclusively virtual schools located in Los Angeles County that have an SAT excellence rate above 0.25 and a free meal eligibility rate for students aged 5–17 higher than the average among all locally funded schools.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  s."XCL_047" AS name,
  s."XCL_053" || ', ' || s."XCL_055" || ', ' || s."XCL_057" || ' ' || s."XCL_051" AS full_mailing_address
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
JOIN satscores AS sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
WHERE s."XCL_076" = 'F'
  AND s."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" > 0.25
  AND CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" > (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(f2."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f2."XCL_024")
    FROM frpm AS f2
    JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2."XCL_001" = s2."XCL_041"
    WHERE s2."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
  )
